title: Integrations
description: Connect your space to payments, locks, public bookings, and calendars. Configure once, then it runs in the background.

publicBooking.title: Public booking page
publicBooking.description: Let visitors book desks and meeting rooms without an account.
publicBooking.noTelegramBanner: Without Telegram connected, you'll only see new bookings when you open the calendar. Connect Telegram in the Notifications page for instant alerts.
publicBooking.offlinePassesDesc: Show your day / week / month / flex passes and prices on the public page even without Stripe. Visitors send a request and you arrange payment (cash, transfer). Leave off for a plain day-booking page with no pass wall.
publicBooking.b2bInvoicingToggle: Let visitors book as a company
publicBooking.b2bInvoicingDesc: Show the "I'm booking for my company" option on the public page so visitors can add company details for an invoice. Applies to both desk and meeting room bookings.
publicBooking.meetingRoomBookingDesc: Let visitors book meeting rooms on the public page.
publicBooking.privateOfficeDesc: Visitors can request the office (or register interest if it's occupied) — nothing else to configure here.
publicBooking.embedDesc: Paste this into your site (Wix, WordPress, Squarespace, or plain HTML) — no coding needed.
publicBooking.embedNote: Uses the "Link to" scope picked above for {{target}}. Paid bookings open in a secure popup window — the rest happens right on your page.
publicBooking.nonAdminNote: Ask a space owner or admin to configure public booking.

stripe.title: Stripe
stripe.description: Add paid passes to your public booking page — visitors pay via Stripe before their spot is confirmed.
stripe.disconnectDesc: This will remove your Stripe keys and disable payment collection on the public booking page.
stripe.webhookInstructions: Add this in Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks. Select these events: checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.expired
stripe.webhookSubscriptionsNote: , invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted. Weekly and monthly auto-renew needs the invoice and subscription events or renewals will charge the card but never book the next desk.
stripe.webhookNonSubNote: . Day, flex, room, and one-time pass payments only need the checkout events.
stripe.webhookNone: ⚠ No webhook received yet — make sure you've added the URL above in your Stripe Dashboard, then try a test payment. Without it, paid bookings will charge the customer but never get created.
stripe.passTypesAppear: These pass types appear on your public booking page at /book/{{slug}}
stripe.autoRenewDesc: Off by default. When on, those public card checkouts become Stripe Subscriptions — visitors are charged again each cycle until they or you cancel. Off: weekly and monthly stays a one-time payment, same as today.
stripe.onlineInvoicesDesc: Adds a Pay button on unpaid invoices in the member portal. Payments are reconciled automatically.
stripe.nonAdminNote: Ask a space owner or admin to configure Stripe.

smartLocks.title: Smart Locks
smartLocks.description: Auto-unlock the front door for active bookings via Nuki, August, Yale, Salto, Latch, and 13+ more brands. Flex members' balances burn only on actual entry.
smartLocks.upgradeBanner: Available on the Premium plan. Upgrade to connect your existing lock vendor account and issue PINs to every booking automatically. Flex day plans switch to burn-on-entry, so members never lose unused days.
smartLocks.nonOwnerNote: Ask a space owner to configure smart locks.
smartLocks.unconnectedDesc: Connect your existing lock vendor account and OhMyDesk will issue a PIN to every member on a booking automatically.
smartLocks.opensSeamNote: Opens a secure Seam window in a new tab.
smartLocks.waitingTitle: Waiting for you to finish setup
smartLocks.waitingDesc: Complete the steps in the Seam window we opened. This card will update automatically when you're done.
smartLocks.accessHoursDesc: Members get access during their booking, within your operating hours (Organization → General). Days you're closed get no code at all.
smartLocks.keypadOk: Keypad detected — every booking gets its own PIN by email.
smartLocks.noKeypad: Your lock vendor reports no PIN support for this lock, so members won't receive access codes.
smartLocks.offlineLockWarning: Your vendor also reports this lock as offline — while it is unreachable it cannot report a keypad. Get it back online in the vendor's own app first (a Nuki Smart Lock needs its Bridge; a Pro needs Wi-Fi), then Refresh below.
smartLocks.pairedKeypadAdvice: If a keypad is already paired, check that it shows up on this lock in the vendor's own app (Nuki, August, ...), then Refresh below.
smartLocks.disconnectDesc: Your lock vendor account will be unlinked from OhMyDesk. Members on active bookings will stop receiving access codes. You can reconnect at any time.
smartLocks.pickLockHeader: Pick the lock at your space's entrance ({{count}} available)
smartLocks.noLocksFound: No locks found in your connected account yet. If you just added one, click refresh.
smartLocks.doorCodesNote: Door codes follow Operating Hours (Organization → General). Closed days get no code.
smartLocks.disconnectShortDesc: Your lock vendor account will be unlinked from OhMyDesk. You can reconnect at any time.

calendarSync.title: Calendar sync
calendarSync.description: Subscribe to a live read-only feed of {{name}} bookings in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, or any iCal-compatible app. Updates roughly every hour.
calendarSync.noToken: No calendar token yet — try refreshing.
calendarSync.arrivalsDesc: Two events per booking: → arrives on the first day, ✕ ends on the last day. Recommended.
calendarSync.allDesc: One event per person per booked day. Useful for full coverage but cluttered.
calendarSync.notifyDesc: Adds a calendar alert to every arrival, departure, and meeting room booking.
calendarSync.resubscribeNote: Re-subscribe in your calendar app to pick up reminder changes.
calendarSync.keepPrivate: Keep this URL private. Anyone with the link can read your bookings.
calendarSync.googleCalStep1: Open Google Calendar on the web
calendarSync.googleCalStep2: Left sidebar → Other calendars → + → From URL
calendarSync.googleCalStep3: Paste the URL above and click Add calendar
calendarSync.appleCalStep2: Or: Calendar → File → New Calendar Subscription → paste URL
calendarSync.outlookStep1: Outlook → Calendar → Add calendar → Subscribe from web
calendarSync.outlookStep2: Paste the URL above and name the calendar
calendarSync.otherAppsDesc: Use the URL above as a remote/network calendar (CalDAV-compatible apps may also accept it).
calendarSync.regenerateDesc: Your current URL will stop working immediately. Any calendar app already subscribed will need to be re-pointed at the new URL.

concierge.title: Concierge
concierge.description: Visitors ask about your space — pricing, availability, what's included. The AI drafts replies from your space data; you review before anything goes out.
concierge.upgradeBanner: Available on the Premium plan. Upgrade to give your space a 24/7 AI concierge — share a link and anyone who messages gets an instant draft reply, ready for your review before it sends.
concierge.shareLinkDesc: Share anywhere — website, Instagram bio, Telegram group. Anyone who messages gets an instant AI-drafted reply, ready for your review before it sends.
concierge.nonAdminNote: Prefer replies from your own Telegram bot? Ask a space owner or admin to connect one.
concierge.ownBotConnected: Connected{{username}}. New messages get an AI-drafted reply for you to review.
concierge.disconnectDesc: We'll remove the webhook from your bot, so incoming messages stop creating AI-drafted replies. Past messages are kept, and your shared OhMyDesk link keeps working.
concierge.botFatherHint: Create a bot with @BotFather on Telegram, then paste its token here — we connect it automatically.
concierge.knowledgePlaceholder: Parking, Wi-Fi, coffee, noise level, house rules — anything you'd tell a visitor at the door…
concierge.knowledgeDesc: Answers questions the concierge can't get from your space data. When it finds the answer here it replies directly; otherwise it offers to check with the team.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp concierge
whatsapp.description: Connect your own WhatsApp Business number. Visitors message you; the AI replies from your space data. Meta bills your Business Manager, not OhMyDesk.
whatsapp.upgradeDesc: Visitors message your WhatsApp Business number. The same AI that answers Telegram replies from your hours, prices, and live desks.
whatsapp.upgradeBanner: Available on the Premium plan. Connect your own WhatsApp Business number and the concierge answers in the visitor's language.
whatsapp.connectedDesc: Connected{{displayName}}{{displayPhone}}. New messages get an instant AI reply.
whatsapp.metaConfigSubhead: Paste these into Meta → WhatsApp → Configuration
whatsapp.metaInstructions: Subscribe the app to messages. First replies stay inside the 24-hour window. Booking-alert templates are a later step.
whatsapp.disconnectDesc: Incoming messages will stop creating AI replies. Past messages are kept. Remove the webhook in Meta if you want to stop deliveries too.
whatsapp.nonAdminNote: Ask a space owner or admin to connect the space's WhatsApp Business number.
whatsapp.setupStep1: In Meta Business Manager, verify the business and create a WhatsApp Business Account with a dedicated number (not a personal WhatsApp).
whatsapp.setupStep2: Create a Meta app, add WhatsApp, and generate a permanent system-user token with whatsapp_business_messaging.
whatsapp.setupStep3: Copy the phone number ID, the token, and the app secret. After connect, paste the callback URL and verify token back into Meta.

copilot.title: Operator Autopilot
copilot.description: Chat with @OhMyDesk_bot to ask about your space — schedule, occupancy, revenue, members and leads, answered instantly from your live data.
copilot.upgradeBanner: Available on the Premium plan. Upgrade to chat with @OhMyDesk_bot and get instant answers about your space — no dashboard needed.
copilot.prompt2: How many desks are free this week?
copilot.readOnlyNote: Read-only for now — taking actions from chat (bookings, invoices) is coming soon.
copilot.connectBanner: Connect @OhMyDesk_bot — the same bot that sends your notifications — then ask it anything about your space.

api.title: API
api.description: Programmatic access to your booking data — availability, bookings, and office requests today, with member management coming next. Authenticate every request with a per-space API key.
api.newKeyWarning: Copy it now — for your security, it won't be shown again.
api.nonAdminNote: Only owners and admins can create or revoke API keys.
api.errorForbidden: Only owners and admins can create API keys.
api.errorGeneric: Couldn't create the key. Please try again.
api.errorRevoke: Couldn't revoke the key. Please try again.

request.title: Need something else?
request.description: Tell us which tool to plug in next. We prioritize based on demand from operators like you.
request.successTitle: Got it — request for {{name}} received. We read every one and email back if it lands on the roadmap.
request.useCaseLabel: What would you do with it?
request.useCasePlaceholder: e.g. Notify the team Slack channel on new bookings
request.rateLimited: Sent one already — give it a minute before another.
request.submitFailed: Couldn't submit ({{reason}}). Try again or email hello@ohmydesk.app.
request.genericError: Something broke. Try again, or email hello@ohmydesk.app.
request.footerNote: We'll email {{email}} when it ships. Powered by the same feedback inbox as /feedback.

toasts.stripeLinkedDesc: Your Stripe account is now linked.
toasts.autoRenewEnabledDesc: Weekly and monthly public passes will charge again each cycle until cancelled.
toasts.autoRenewDisabledDesc: Weekly and monthly public passes are one-time payments again. Existing Stripe subscriptions keep billing until cancelled.
toasts.paymentEnabledDesc: Visitors can now pay for this plan online.
toasts.paymentDisabledDesc: This plan is now free to book.
toasts.calendarCopiedDesc: Calendar feed URL copied to clipboard.
toasts.reSubscribeCalendar: The old URL is now invalid. Re-subscribe in your calendar app.
toasts.missingMetaFieldsDesc: Paste the access token, phone number ID, and app secret from Meta.
toasts.whatsappConnectedDefault: Your WhatsApp number is now connected.
toasts.botDisconnectedDesc: Your bot is no longer connected.
toasts.couldNotStartTelegram: Could not start the Telegram connection.
toasts.failedSaveFrontDoor: Failed to save front door lock.
